# S1.13 — Land the credential mediation & secret isolation (§5g.3, R-2.8.3 C0/Stage 1)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5g.3 (`R-2.8.3` — the C0/Stage-1 slice per
§5g.3 §9) · ADR-0057/0058/0059 · ADR-0023/0024 · ADR-0026/0029/0031 ·
ADR-0033/0034/0035 · ADR-0036/0037 · ADR-0051/0052/0053 · ADR-0066 Rule P ·
ADR-0212 (OQ-132 interim `ResourcePattern`)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/017_S1.13__credential-broker.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.8.3**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.12` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 · **Live
stage:** offline-only

## Summary
Lands the credential mediation & secret isolation floor's C0/Stage-1 slice as
the new **persistent** crate `crates/hh-secrets` (deps
`hh-wire`/`hh-identity`/`hh-provenance`/`hh-ontology`/`hh-hir`/`hh-ledger`/
`hh-monitor`/`hh-containment` only — no `Text` leaf authored, no model call on
any path):

- **Value-free records** (`types.rs`/`channel.rs`) — `SecretRef{channel_id,
  description}` (the only model-facing form), `ProvidedSecret{provided}` (the
  only permitted value fact — `yes/no`), `SecretFingerprint` (keyed,
  truncated, irreversible), `Placeholder` (`mh_secret:v1:<channel>:r<rev>:
  <nonce>` — the nonce an `idp/1`-framed digest over `run_id ∥ binding_id`,
  binding-scoped and non-transferable, SV-10), `SecretChannelSpec` verbatim
  (`CredentialKind`, `SecretSource{operator_vault|os_keyring|launch_env|
  external_binding}`, `DestinationBinding`, `AuthCarrier`, `SenderConstraint`,
  `canary`, `bindable`, `delivery_modes_allowed`, `max_lifetime`,
  `allowed_env_names`), strict canonical codecs (`BadMember`/`BadValue`).
  `BindingMode` **is** `hh_monitor::assess::SecretTransport` — no second mode
  vocabulary (CC1/CC7).
- **The kernel-side `CredentialBroker`** (`broker.rs`) — `register_channel`
  (never reads the value), `grant` (scope ⊆ channel destinations ⇒
  `ScopeExceedsChannel`; issuer ≥ `principal` ⇒ `IssuerAuthorityInsufficient`),
  `bind` (PDP gate → mode/isolation/canary checks → `security.credential.bound`
  durable **before** the binding is visible), `mediate` (§5's normative refusal
  order `revoked → expired → out_of_scope → ambiguous_path → canary →
  decision_missing → broker_unavailable`; a staged `Delivery` whose `claim_id`
  names a kernel-held value slot — the wire rewrite is S2.4's),
  `revoke`/`on_run_terminal` (idempotent; SV-6), `rotate` (CAS
  `Conflict{current}`; the outgoing value retained in the mask set *before* the
  swap — unresolvable ⇒ refuse; `rotated`+`revoked` in one durable batch),
  `kernel_use` (the `bindable=false`/`kernel_only` path — `used{destination =
  kernel:<purpose>}`), `fingerprint`, `mask_set` (**fails closed** — an
  unresolvable source is `BrokerUnavailable`, never an incomplete mask set),
  `leak_scan_run`, `env_spec_for`, `terminal_secret_unavailable`.
- **The PDP/CDP gate** (`decisions.rs`) — `DecisionView` folds the run's
  committed `security.permission.{granted,decided,revoked}` rows;
  `bind`/`mediate` require a `decided{decision = allow}` covering a live
  `secret_access` handle for the holder over `secret:<channel_id>` — else
  `DecisionMissing`. The broker never decides; a revoked handle uncovers at
  delivery (AC-R-2.8.3-13).
- **Deny-by-default environment** (`env.rs`) — `env_apply`: only allow-listed
  names carry; `KERNEL_NONINHERITABLE` + credential-shaped suffixes
  (`_API_KEY`/`_TOKEN`/`_SECRET`/`_SECRET_KEY`/`_PASSWORD`/`_CREDENTIALS`/
  `_PRIVATE_KEY`) withheld **even when allow-listed**; bound channels project
  placeholders only; known secret values inside ordinary allowed vars are
  masked at projection; `dump()`/`proc_env()`/`snapshot()` are one projected
  map — no second form can carry a value (SV-4).
- **Redaction at source + the leak battery** (`redact.rs`/`mask.rs`/
  `patterns.rs`) — `redact` replaces hits with content-free
  `REDACTED[<detector>:<fingerprint|label>]` tombstones; `leak_scan` over
  `ScanTarget{event|blob|request_view|definition|sink_delivery|mediation}` is
  the test-battery verifier (`leak_scan(run) = ∅` is LT-01's verdict) — never
  a live interceptor; the registered std-only token-shape detectors (Google /
  AWS / GitHub / OpenAI / PEM / Slack) — encoded variants are C1.
- **Canary tripwire** — a `canary` channel is never injected: `bind`/
  `mediate`/`kernel_use` append `security.secret.leak_detected{location =
  "mediation:<verb>:<channel>", detector = canary}` durably, then refuse
  `Refused{canary}` (ADR-0059 D3).
- **The four veto declarations** (`metrics.rs`) — `secret_value_in_{ledger,
  model_context,environment,report}` (`veto: true`, `requires_mediation:
  broker`, deterministic detectors only).
- **Definition/diff gates** (`defscan.rs`) — `seal_checked`/`check_diff`:
  a literal credential fails `seal` with `HirError::SecretValueInDefinition`;
  `$secret:<channel>` is the legal reference form (AC-R-2.8.3-8).
- **Additive edits** — `hh-ledger`: the seven `security.credential.{bound,
  used,denied,revoked,rotated}` + `security.secret.{redacted,leak_detected}`
  class rows (audit-grade, kernel-origin, provenance-mandatory); `hh-identity`:
  `RecordKind::SecretChannel`/`CredentialBinding`; `hh-hir`:
  `HirError::SecretValueInDefinition`, `HirDocument::text_leaves()` (recursive
  `Text` enumeration), `HirDiff::to_json()`/`canonical_bytes()`; `hh-assembly`:
  the diagnostic mirror; `hh-monitor`: `SecretTransport::{as_str,parse}` +
  `Ord`/`Hash`.

## Verification
- `cargo test -p hh-secrets` — **18 green** (1 lib + 4 acceptance + 13 SV).
- `cargo test --workspace` — all suites green, zero failures.
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` — clean.
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` — clean (zero warnings).
- `check-build-memory.sh .` — 0 violations (BM-ADR-04 appendix-vs-repo warning
  unchanged).
- Live verification n/a — offline-only; the resolver SPI (`StaticVault`/
  `LaunchEnvResolver`) is the in-process vault boundary; no live vault,
  keyring, egress mediator or environment handle exists at Stage 1.

Closed: none.

## Decisions
ADR-0244 — crate shape; the recorded-input PDP/CDP gate; the staged `mediate`;
the deny-by-default env projection; the mask-set/redaction split (verifier,
not interceptor); rotation's CAS+retention batch; the canary tripwire; the
closed refusal vocabulary. Also records the deliberate early landing of the
`mediate`/`rotate`/`grant`/`kernel_use` verb surface (§9 lists them Stage 2;
AC-13 exercises `mediate` at Stage 1 — additive, not a re-decision).
